result: Judge what actually happened, not what the method is called. Was its purpose explained to you? Did you agree to it? How did the practitioner respond to you? Discomfort alone doesn't settle the matter, but it deserves scrutiny when every objection is treated as proof that you need more of the same. You can ask the app or another informed person for an explanation, though you shouldn't expect them to certify a practitioner from a brief account. Whether to try self-hypnosis, combined work, or another practitioner remains your choice.
